u1: The matching key has been seen (key_found latched) but the agent does not yet carry it. Next objective: move to the key's cell and pick it up so has_matching_key becomes true.
u2: The agent carries the matching key but the locked target door is still closed. Next objective: navigate to the target room's left-wall door and toggle it open, which requires the matching key and makes target_door_open true.
u3: The locked target door is open, but the agent has not yet entered the target room. Next objective: step through the doorway into the target room (the doorway cell counts as inside) so target_room_entered becomes true.
u4: The agent has entered the target room and is still holding the matching key, so it cannot pick up the ball. Next objective: drop the matching key onto an empty cell so it is no longer carried; this, combined with the target door remaining open, advances to u5.
u5: The target door is open and the matching key has been dropped, so the agent's hands are free inside the target room. Next objective: locate the mission ball and pick it up, which completes the mission and advances to u6.
u6: Terminal success state: the mission ball has been picked up. The episode has terminated and no further action is needed.
